scope:
Independent actual-daemon DNS boundary audit, exact image versus fresh Rust.

Requires run_isolated.sh. Reuses only m2_rootfs's identity-checked disposable
image overlay; packet generation, stub upstream and comparisons are independent.
All addresses are synthetic and all listeners remain in the private namespace.

local.config:
port=15353
listen-address=127.0.0.1
bind-interfaces
no-hosts
no-resolv
cache-size=0
no-round-robin
local-ttl=60
host-record=host.audit.test,192.0.2.42,2001:db8::42
local=/audit.test/
cname=alias.audit.test,host.audit.test
cname=chain.audit.test,alias.audit.test
txt-record=txt.audit.test,hello
mx-host=mail.audit.test,host.audit.test,10
srv-host=_service._tcp.audit.test,host.audit.test,123,1,2
